title: Filters and badges
description: Serves "Finding something to watch is easy."; "Their languages come first.". Absorbs JS-046's genres and persons and JS-047's filters.
acceptanceCriteria: Films and Shows filter by unwatched, audio and subtitle language, audio description and SDH, 4K and HDR, genre and person, combined with AND.
A viewer's filter is remembered for them.
4K, HDR, audio description and SDH show as badges on a title.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
